queries.curatorByPath: query curatorByPath($path: String!, $variation: String = "master") { curatorByPath(_path: $path, variation: $variation) { item { _path name region bio { plaintext } image { ... on ImageRef { _path _authorUrl _publishUrl _dynamicUrl width height } } ctaLabel ctaLink } } }
queries.destinationByPath: query destinationByPath($path: String!, $variation: String = "master") { destinationByPath(_path: $path, variation: $variation) { item { _path name country tagline image { ... on ImageRef { _path _authorUrl _publishUrl _dynamicUrl width height } } link } } }
queries.serviceByPath: query serviceByPath($path: String!, $variation: String = "master") { serviceByPath(_path: $path, variation: $variation) { item { _path number title description { plaintext } link } } }
queries.testimonialByPath: query testimonialByPath($path: String!, $variation: String = "master") { testimonialByPath(_path: $path, variation: $variation) { item { _path quote { plaintext } author location featured } } }
